scope: Append concise speech guidance to the existing answer_prompt through the native authenticated revision-checked settings API; no product code or API calculation changes.
checks: Simple single-metric answers are concise; material incompleteness must still be disclosed and partial totals cannot be presented as complete.
Existing answer_prompt is preserved verbatim as a prefix; request_planning_prompt and answer_extra_instruction are preserved and checked.
Initial file hash and revision checks, recovery lock, active-job guard, local backup, native stale revision rejection and exact readback are present.
Uses configured allowed IPC peer without changing access; native save persists atomically with mode 0600 and fsync.
Ambiguous transport/JSON save outcome causes read-only reconciliation without a second save; explicit API errors abort.
Release pointer, manifest and config equality are checked after save.
Installer and embedded IPC client compile; IPC frame terminator is a newline.

tests.independently_observed: Static source review, Python AST/compile validation and native settings/gateway contract comparison

limitations: No live or paid calls executed by reviewer.
Current server revision/hash, installation readback and actual column response must be confirmed by installing agent.
Prompt-only behavioral improvement remains probabilistic and needs the planned column acceptance retest.
